top_signals.title: Musk's clash with Ukraine accelerates demand for Starlink alternatives. Few exist
top_signals.summary: Governments or companies looking for an alternative to SpaceX's Starlink are faced with few options, as Amazon, Eutelsat and others are far behind.

top_signals.title: ‘Paralyzed’ US IPO Market Asks If There’s Life After Anthropic
top_signals.summary: The debate over artificial intelligence is keeping IPOs stuck on the launching pad, and with the shadow of Anthropic PBC’s market debut looming larger by the day, billions of dollars of capital and months of preparations are hanging in the balance.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Retirement Longevity Risk a Top Factor for Investors
top_signals.summary:
Many older Americans do not feel comfortable spending money on pleasure due to fear of outliving their savings.
Costs are rising in almost every aspect of life, particularly healthcare, which eats up more of a retiree’s budget as they age.
Marta Norton, Chief Investment Strategist at Empower, discusses the market landscape and how the current workforce should invest for longevity when it comes to their retirement. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Partners’ EyeCare Set to Close Deal to Repay Debt at Discount
top_signals.summary: EyeCare Partners is set to close a deal with its creditors this week to sell assets and repay its debt at a discount, according to people familiar with the matter.
